metadata.title: Multimodal Transportation | Ethio Rail Logistics
metadata.description: Connected road, rail, inland, port, and ocean logistics stages for coordinated cargo movement.

hero.title: One journey. Multiple modes. One coordinated movement.
hero.description: EthioRail coordinates movement across road, rail, inland logistics points, ports, and ocean connections as part of a connected cargo journey.
hero.imageAlt: Ethiopian Railway freight train and container handling equipment at an intermodal terminal.

overview.title: Different modes, understood as one journey.
paragraphs: Multimodal transportation brings more than one transport mode into a coordinated cargo movement. Road connections, rail corridors, inland logistics points, port gateways, and ocean routes can each have a place in the same journey.
The service is about making those transitions easier to understand and coordinate, so the movement is planned around the route and the cargo rather than treated as a series of disconnected handoffs.

journey.title: A connected sequence from origin to destination.

steps.title: Origin / Cargo Collection
steps.description: Cargo begins at its origin and is prepared for the first connection.

steps.title: Road Connection
steps.description: Inland road movement connects the origin with the next logistics point.

steps.title: Inland Logistics / Dry Port
steps.description: Cargo can be staged, handled, or transferred as the journey changes mode.

steps.title: Rail Corridor
steps.description: Rail provides a corridor connection for the next part of the movement.
